title: Français 3675 — Louis XIII à Béthune, 30 juin 1629
contents: Louis XIII nominates the Archbishop of Lyon for a cardinal’s hat, citing the services of his brother Richelieu.
status: 1/2 pages transcribed; 1 more in part; Partly deciphered
fields: Interlinear plaintext on f53r; shared signs checked against interlinear passages on f83r–v and f136r. ·

excerpts.folio: f53r, three complete cipher-bearing rows and preceding cleartext
excerpt: vous les fassiez valloir et peser à sa Saincteté y adjoustant de plus la recommandation des grands **services de mon cousin le cardinal de Richelieu son frere de qui le [passage rayé] la conduicte et les actions sont**
translation: you should make these qualities count and carry weight with His Holiness, adding also the recommendation of the great services of my cousin Cardinal Richelieu, his brother, whose [cancelled text] conduct and actions are…
